name: camera-hacking
description: Investigate, reverse-engineer, develop, and validate digital-camera modifications and interoperability, including custom firmware, hidden settings, camera control protocols, feature unlocks, and model-specific recovery. Use for feasibility research, offline analysis, controlled experiments, and explicitly authorized installation on photographic, cinema, and action cameras across manufacturers, especially Fujifilm X and Ricoh GR. Do not use for ordinary photography advice, routine vendor firmware updates, media editing, or unauthorized camera access.
